summary: Negotiation exhausted after 3 rounds — price gap USD 230/MT unbridgeable
root_cause: Buyer ceiling USD 950/MT, supplier floor USD 1,180/MT. Gap of USD 230/MT (19.5%) could not be closed after 3 negotiation rounds. Supplier's floor is constrained by recent input cost increases. No middle ground available within PortLess margin requirements.

remediation_steps.description: Notify buyer that negotiation has failed and deal cannot proceed at current price levels
remediation_steps.result: HITL escalation raised — operator to confirm cancellation

remediation_steps.description: Source alternative supplier with lower price floor for same commodity
Cancel deal and release any reserved resources

resolution_note: Escalated to HITL approval with CANCEL recommendation.
